title: CARLA: Adjusted common average referencing for cortico-cortical evoked potential data
description: This dataset contains intracranial EEG recordings from four epilepsy patients undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation, collected to develop and validate CARLA, an adjusted common average referencing method for cortico-cortical evoked potential (CCEP) analysis. The data were recorded at Mayo Clinic and support methodological research on referencing schemes for intracranial stimulation-response data. This release includes raw data sufficient to reproduce most published results, with some data censored pending future publications.
methods_description: Patients rested in a hospital bed while single pulse electrical stimulation was applied at a frequency of ~0.2 Hz. Each stimulation pulse was biphasic, lasted 200 microseconds, and had an amplitude of 6 mA. Intracranial EEG was recorded in response to the stimulation.
